summary: Tested the USDT income / MERQ withdrawal changes, the global GM tree, the token icon, the Start Now rename and the Connect Wallet rename on Atlas (production) with a temp member and a temp admin; all temp data was removed afterwards. Sims (local DB): engine_sim shows A partner onboarding = 3720 USD (62 x 60), MB paid 400 / saved 300, all credited as USD into available/income/income_usd. port_sim values are all correct USD. gm_global_sim: GM has a single root and fills level-by-level in purchase order across teams (A,B -> a1,b1 under A -> a2,b2 under B -> a3,b3 under a1); MB1 stays under sponsor (b1 under B). Atlas GM tree has a single root (0xc1aca). Backend pytest 7/7 passed: quote 20 -> fee 1, net_usdt 19, merq_receive=19/price, merq_fee=1/price, fee_pct 5; <10 rejected (Minimum), >available rejected; 20 USDT request auto-processed -> payout_failed with 'Treasury wallet does not hold enough MERQ' (treasury MERQ=0, verified before testing); a second immediate request has no cooldown; available decreased 50->30->20; withdrawal doc stores currency USDT, merq_price, net (MERQ), fee_merq; history and admin list OK. UI: /withdraw shows label 'Amount (USDT)', available in USDT, quote rows Amount/Fee(5%)/Net amount in USDT, MERQ rate and You Receive in MERQ (withdraw-merq-receive); submit gives a queued toast and the balance updates; the mobile layout works. /swap is USDT<->MERQ (flip works) and the MERQ chip shows /merq-token.png. The dashboard coin loads. Landing: 3 Start Now elements, no 'Launch App'; tokenomics-token-logo /merq-token.png has naturalWidth 520; the Add MERQ to MetaMask button is present (shows a 'MetaMask not found' toast when no wallet). /app, /register and /admin show 'Connect Wallet', no 'MetaMask / Injected'. The income stream page shows USDT. Admin Income Reports has a USDT column. Admin Withdrawals columns are Amount (USDT), Fee (USDT), Sends (MERQ). Found 1 HIGH backend bug: admin withdrawal reject can be repeated and refunds the balance every time.

critical.issue: Rejecting a withdrawal that is already 'rejected' succeeds again and refunds w.amount to available a second time. Reproduced: available 0 -> 10 -> 20 for a single 10 USDT withdrawal. 'release' also moves a rejected withdrawal back to 'pending', so it can then be approved and paid AFTER the refund (a double-spend). The reject path is also non-atomic: it does find_one and then an unconditional update, so a double-click or concurrent requests can double-refund.

minor.issue: Negative and zero amounts are not validated. amount=-5 returns negative fee and negative merq_receive. Add amount>0 validation (400).

The auto-approve threshold default is inconsistent: the cooldown check uses settings.get('withdraw_auto_approve_under', 5000) but the auto check uses the default 1000. Atlas has 5000 set, so there is no impact today; align both defaults to 5000.

Every GM placement does a BFS from the global root using one find_one per node, so the cost grows with company size. There is also no lock: concurrent purchases can pick the same parent and give it more than 2 children. Consider a 'next open slot' pointer or an atomic $push guarded by a children size check.

ui_bugs.issue: The field label reads 'NEEDS APPROVAL ABOVE (MERQ)', but withdrawal limits and the threshold are now in USDT. It should read '(USDT)'.

issues: 'MERQ PRICE' label touches the value, and the price is unrounded: '$0.5002043575089995'. Format to about 4-6 decimals.
Shows '+60.00 USDT' followed by '$60.00'. The amount is now USD, so the second value is redundant.
The 'Team Volume' card still shows the unit as MERQ ('0 MERQ'). Check whether it should be USDT.
The native number spinner renders with a white background on the dark theme.
Date filters use the browser's native mm/dd/yyyy picker and a native select, not the shadcn calendar/select.
/merq-token.png is 435KB and is used at 22-64px sizes (swap chip, dashboard). Use merq-token-256.png (134KB) or a webp for small sizes.

action_items: HIGH: Make withdrawal reject atomic and allowed only from pending/under_review/payout_failed, e.g. find_one_and_update({_id, status: {$in: [...]}}, {$set: {status: 'rejected'}}) and refund only if a doc was matched. Restrict 'release' to under_review -> pending.
Change the admin Withdrawals label 'Needs approval above (MERQ)' to USDT.
Align the withdraw_auto_approve_under defaults (1000 vs 5000) in withdraw_request.
Round the sidebar MERQ price and fix the label spacing. Remove the duplicate $ value in the income history rows. Check the Team Volume unit.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_panel.withdrawal_action reject/hold/release perform no state-transition checks, apart from reject blocking sent/completed/processing.

process_payout: if treasury_status returns merq_balance=None (RPC error), it proceeds to send_merq. That path re-checks the balance, so it is safe, but the fee transfer can fail after the net was sent; that case is recorded only in fee_error, with no retry path.
The GM global BFS in place() is O(N) DB round-trips per purchase and is not concurrency-safe.

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested checks (7/7 pytest + 3 sims); 1 HIGH bug found outside the requested scope (admin reject double refund)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested items pass; 1 label still says MERQ)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Atlas is production. Flow: `python tests/atlas_snapshot.py /tmp/before.json`; `python tests/atlas_withdraw_env.py setup` (writes /tmp/wd_env.json with member_jwt/admin_jwt; the member has available=50, status active and a confirmed TP); `pytest tests/test_withdraw_usdt.py -n 0`; then `python tests/atlas_withdraw_env.py cleanup`. Check that the treasury MERQ balance is 0 before any withdrawal test (/tmp/treas.py-style check via payout.treasury_status). For the reject fix: create a temp withdrawal, reject it twice, and assert that the second reject returns 400 and available is refunded only once.
